item.title: Shirat Hayam Congregant Donations
item.description: (Left to right): Shirat Hayam congregants Joyce Schwartz, Marlyn Rose and Lisa Naegele donated more than 20 bags and boxes of food to Jewish Family Service of Atlantic & Cape May Counties. The food will be distributed to local residents for the Passover holiday.

item.title: Beth Sholom Members Go To The UN Commission On The Status of Women.
item.description: Susan Miller, National President of NA’AMAT USA, and Talia Caplan, Executive Director of Seeding the Dream and co-founder of I Believe Israeli Women, both from Elkins Park and Beth Sholom members, met at the Romanian Mission with other delegates to discuss gender equality during the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women.

item.title: Matzah Making at Kaiserman JCC ELC!
item.description: Kaiserman JCC Early Learning Center learns to make matzah.

item.title: Chabad of the Main Line Special With Former Hostage Omer Shem Tov
item.description: Rabbi Shraga Sherman, left, former hostage Omer Shem Tov, center, and Mrs. Michal Sherman stand in front of a crowd of over 425 people who came to a special Chabad of the Main Line event on March 18, where Shem Tov spoke about resilience, faith and the human spirit.

item.title: USCJ’s Jewish Educators Assembly Conference in Philly
item.description: Jewish Educators from across different communities gathered in Philadelphia for the USCJ’s Jewish Educators Assembly Conference.

item.title: Birth Announcement: Tali Rose Peterman
item.description: Andrea Highbloom and Scott Peterman, along with big sister Eliana Sophia, announce the birth of their second daughter and sister, Tali Rose on December 30th 2025.

item.title: 65 Women Travel to Panama During Women’s History Month
item.description: From March 1-5, 65 local women traveled to Panama on a Women’s Philanthropy mission with the Jewish Federation of Greater Philadelphia.

item.title: Kaitlyn Arms: Furthering Her Grandfather’s Legacy In Jewish Activism
item.description: For Kaitlyn Arms, education initiatives manager at Gratz College, working in Jewish professional life was a calling of sorts. Her grandfather was the late Charles Davidson, a legendary cantor and composer. Arms was his only grandchild, and they had what she called a “special relationship.”

item.title: Philly Rabbi Makes Divorce the Focus of His Rabbinical Work
item.description: The Jewish ketubah signing includes financial protections for the woman in case the marriage breaks apart. While the focus on the woman was perhaps written for a different time, its wisdom is clear: Jewish communities understand the reality of divorce.

item.title: Navigating Cholesterol: What You Need to Know for a Healthy Heart
item.description: With so much information available, it can be difficult to understand what cholesterol is — and why it’s important.
